title: 🏡 FHA loans = more flexibility.
description:
🏡 FHA loans = more flexibility.

Think of it as a bigger box more buyers can fit into.

✔️ Lower credit options (as low as 580 for 3.5% down)
✔️ Higher DTI allowed (even up to 55%+)
✔️ Down payment as low as 3.5%

That’s why FHA works for many first-time buyers

If you’re military, a veteran, or planning to buy in Central Texas, we’re here to help.

📩 Send us a message and we’ll guide you.
